title.narrative: Climate Resilient Green Growth in the Solomon Islands

description.narrative: To support the Solomon Islands in planning and scaling up the implementation of climate-resilient green growth interventions, leveraging finance from various sources to achieve climate change targets and enhance resilience at the provincial and community levels.

aims to enhance climate resilience and promote green growth at the national and subnational levels. The project will support the Solomon Islands government in mainstreaming climate resilience into provincial policy planning and budgeting processes. It will also mobilize increased climate finance and green investments for impactful projects. Key activities include stakeholder engagement, capacity building, and the development of climate-resilient strategies and action plans. The project will be implemented over three years by GGGI in close partnership with relevant Solomon Islands ministries and provincial governments, with the support of DFAT Australia's funding and strategic guidance.
